narrative.benchmark_md: Peer benchmarking uses a 5-peer set locked at Layer 0 Batch 1 and immutable per Rule R7: Visions FCU ($5.49B), AmeriCU ($2.5B), Hudson Valley CU ($7.95B), CFCU Community CU ($1.5B), and ESL FCU ($8.5B). The set deliberately brackets Empower's $4.07B mid-Medium tier position with both upward (ESL, Hudson Valley) and lateral / downward (CFCU, AmeriCU) benchmarks. All peers are NCUA-supervised consumer-financial-services credit unions; geographic overlap weighted toward Central / Upstate NY where possible.
narrative.issue_register_md: This section is borrowed from the Layer 0 Client Profile Research Report (§5.1 Issue Register) with assessment-layer Severity-Capped Capability Impact analysis added.

per_pillar_md.P1: Empower trails the peer median in every one of the 17 categories assessed. Narrowest gaps cluster in ESG (−0.38) and Data Management (−0.36); widest gap is Compliance (−1.32). The pattern is gap-everywhere, with widest gaps concentrated in P1 cluster (governance + strategy + culture) and (compliance attestation transparency).
